description: Task-automation skill registry for KrishiAI. Each skill maps a trigger to either an app-layer AI task route (agentic.json.taskRoutes) or a dev-agent (agentic.json.agents / .agent/orchestration/agentic.json.agents), so task automation always resolves through the quota-aware free-model waterfall — never a hardcoded single provider.

skills.description: CABI Plantwise-style crop disease diagnosis from photo/text using multi-provider vision consensus
Multimodal AI chat (image/PDF/doc upload) with provider badge and quota-aware fallback
AEZ-zone soil analysis with USDA texture classification
AI-enriched lookup across the 200+ crop database (7 categories)
Generate/sync Supabase schema and migrations from source-of-truth models
Emit/update GitHub Actions CI and Vercel deploy workflows
Dry-run refactors and environment-variable injection with secret scrubbing
Build/query/export the .agent/docs knowledge graph and orchestration dashboard
Bengali-English bilingual formatting pass for presentation-ready outputs

fallbackPolicy.note: All 'app' layer skills resolve through agentic.json.taskRoutes and never call a provider directly — this keeps quota exhaustion transparent (waterfall to next free provider, then Bengali offline degradation) and avoids silently downgrading response quality.
